method: Only runtime manifest spot polygons and original author CAR archive images[].annotationsRectangle read. No offline occupancy labels, prediction files, or model calls used. Inclusive rectangle.covers(polygon) defines full coverage; nonzero area intersection defines partial coverage. Counts are spot observations unless explicitly marked unique geometry.
adopted_semantics: Root fixed the policy before holdout inference: positive occupied evidence first, ambiguous overlap second, otherwise any not-fully-observed spot is unknown/incomplete_observation; full-image inference has observed ROI None. This audit contains no occupancy truth or model prediction.
limitations: Counts are geometric spot observations, not measured false-free outcomes.
48 partial CNR observations are retained in the full denominator; only actual prediction evaluation can establish how many receive incomplete_observation.
PK geometry is entirely covered, so this guard cannot change existing PK state/matrix results for unchanged detections.
